[CONTEXT & OBJECTIVE]
Submit to batch via Anthropic Batch API: Create comprehensive integration tests for 4thBrain REST API ingestion endpoints. Test POST /api/ingest/text (small text, 300-character text), POST /api/ingest/file (text file submission), POST /api/ingest/url (https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.10435). Test error handling (missing fields), tags support. Verify: HTTP 200 success status, jobId in response, document created in SQLite database with correct metadata, files written to disk, URI locations recorded. Use node:test and node:assert/strict patterns (see server/test/ingest-service.test.js). Use createTestDb() and createTestCfg() test helpers. Create server/test/api-ingestion-integration.test.js with 7+ comprehensive test cases. Run all tests and output final report: test execution summary (pass/fail count), any issues found that need fixing, test coverage assessment, recommendations for improvements.

[EXECUTION CONTEXT]
This request runs inside the Anthropic Batch API (asynchronous, lower cost, fully isolated from user's local session). You are Claude/Opus running on Anthropic's infrastructure. Your task description appears above. Deliver results to stdout as a clear, concise report; Anthropic's batch system will capture this output.

[AUTONOMOUS DIRECTIVES - DEFAULT]
- Proceed end-to-end without asking any clarifying questions.
- Make all reasonable technical and architectural decisions independently based on code patterns.
- When multiple valid approaches exist, pick the RECOMMENDED option if labeled.
- Otherwise, choose the most conservative approach: minimal scope, align with existing patterns, prefer proven solutions.
- Document all non-trivial decisions in DECISIONS.md for later user review — create the file if it doesn't exist.
- Do not use AskUserQuestion or any blocking tools. Always decide and log, then continue.

[EXECUTION PROTOCOL]
1. Explore: Inspect necessary files and tests to understand structure.
2. Implement: Modify or add required files.
3. Validate: Run relevant test suite and linter. Self-correct on errors until suite passes.
4. Decide & Log: Add all non-trivial decisions to DECISIONS.md as you proceed.
5. Conclude: Output a concise final report (stdout):
   - Changes made (files modified/created)
   - Decisions logged (DECISIONS.md contents or key excerpts if any)
   - Test results and validation status
   - Exit cleanly when done.

[BATCH API NOTES]
- This task runs asynchronously on Anthropic's infrastructure (not locally).
- Your output (stdout) and any files created in the working directory will be captured by the batch system.
- The user retrieves results later using the batch ID.
- No local git commits or pushes — leave work as uncommitted changes for the user to review.

[PROJECT CONTEXT - 4thBrain]
- Repository: 4thBrain (privacy-first personal knowledge system)
- Server: Express.js + node:sqlite at C:/Users/rsant/desar/github/4thBrain/server
- Ingestion API: server/routes/ingest.js (POST /api/ingest/file, /text, /url)
- Existing test suite: node:test, 100+ tests in server/test/
- Test helpers: server/test/helpers/{test-db.js, test-cfg.js}
- Database: SQLite with 7 tables (status, job_type, process, classification, document, job, job_document)
- Story 1.1 (Direct Vault Ingestion) COMPLETED
- Story 1.2 (Text Parsing) WIP
- Story 6.1 (Web Ingestion Form) COMPLETED

[DESIGN BEFORE IMPLEMENTATION]
These tests trace to Story 6.1 (Web Ingestion Form) and Story 8.3 (Smoke Tests). Do not modify production code — only add test files.
